app.title: A live tree of systemd jobs on the boot console
app.description: CLI utility that displays a live tree of systemd jobs during boot, aiding debugging of boot sequences.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `./bootvine --help` to verify help output.
Start a simple systemd service and run `./bootvine` to ensure the service appears in the tree.
Measure the time taken for bootvine to render the tree after systemd reaches active state.
